ROOF_OCCLUSION.rule: Runtime draws a roof ABOVE the player, then HIDES it when the player centre is inside that roof polygon. This is real occlusion, not a POI text label.
ROOF_OCCLUSION.whiteboxNote: Reused SOH roof sprites are physical proof, NOT final pixel art / art-complete.

SOLID_COLLISION.mesh: line-segment spans split BY static openings; thickness in U=0.5 tiles
SOLID_COLLISION.terrainCollision: GOLD land/water/cliff candidates from LW-01 sampleAt(); NO artificial marine permission

walkabilitySample.method: runtime BFS using the SAME collision function as real WASD input

circulation.note: Graph BFS is NOT substituted for physical clearance: both are computed and compared.

meaningfulRetreat.note: A retreat point or a room graph is a paper design record, NOT a physically demonstrated exit. Runtime walk proof exists only for the six P3 pilot scenes.

physicalProof.distinguish: Grey boxes / reused SOH sprites prove geometry, collision, doors, roof occlusion and walkability. They are NOT final pixel art and NOT visual acceptance.

runtimeWalkEvidence.note: Runtime WALK / collision / roof-occlusion proof for the ISOLATED six-scene Creator audition ONLY. NOT full Gameplay runtime integration, NOT visual acceptance, NOT art-complete.
